findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:446 resolves review-findings.schema.json through parents[3], which points at .agents/openspec in a normal copied runtime installation rather than the repository-level openspec directory; valid vendor output is therefore rejected as invalid_output outside the canonical source checkout.
findings.resolution: Resolve the schema from a portable installed asset or discover the repository root explicitly, and add a copied-install integration test that validates a known-good findings payload.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_routing.py:34 injects agent-coordinator internals and imports src.agents_config directly, violating the repository's dependency boundary and making skills/install.sh --check fail.
findings.resolution: Resolve reviewer routing through the coordinator's public MCP/HTTP interface or an injected public resolver, with a portable static fallback when the public resolver is unavailable.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_attempts.py:176 checks the monotonic deadline only around a synchronous invoke call and cannot preempt it; async polling and Google SDK invocation ignore the remaining budget, so one hung adapter can still exceed the public per-vendor timeout and prevent later reviewers from running.
findings.resolution: Make every invocation externally cancellable under the remaining monotonic budget, clamp async submit/poll/sleep and SDK timeouts to that remainder, and prevent provider retry behavior from extending the logical deadline.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:1984 accumulates all logical results in memory and the CLI does not persist anything until dispatch_and_wait returns, so a later hang or crash loses already completed terminal evidence; round 2 remained byte-empty for the entire 20-minute dispatch.
findings.resolution: Add an atomic terminal-result checkpoint sink invoked after every logical slot finishes and have the CLI update the manifest/vendor index before moving to the next vendor.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_attempts.py:73 never applies review-attempt.schema.json and its partial relational checks accept illegal chains such as a second initial attempt or unrecognized transition, allowing structurally invalid evidence to be persisted or considered for quorum.
findings.resolution: Apply the Draft 2020-12 schema inside the shared validator, implement an explicit transition automaton with per-vendor fallback/deadline invariants, and require validation in both persistence and quorum paths.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_attempts.py:50 copies provider error_detail verbatim while only stdout and stderr use sanitize_diagnostic, so credential-bearing or oversized exception text can be persisted in manifests and handoffs.
findings.resolution: Sanitize and truncate error_detail with the shared diagnostic helper, propagate its truncation flag, and ensure raw SDK exception strings never enter logs or durable artifacts.

findings.description: Critical: skills/autopilot/scripts/convergence_loop.py:106 validates only selected summary fields when present and omits required per-finding alias relations, accepting reports where status and policy_status, criticality aliases, match aliases, source dispositions, or provisional/unconfirmed counts disagree.
findings.resolution: Require all revision-2 canonical and compatibility fields, validate every per-finding and summary alias plus effective-blocking union semantics, and combine relational validation with JSON Schema validation.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:606 writes consensus reports directly without JSON Schema or relational validation, so CLI and non-autopilot producers can persist contradictory quorum or blocker aliases even though the autopilot consumer validates later.
findings.resolution: Move the complete consensus validator into parallel infrastructure and invoke it inside an atomic write_report implementation before replacing the destination.

findings.description: Critical: skills/autopilot/scripts/convergence_loop.py:127 retains a success-only compatibility path and forwards raw ReviewResult.success into synthesis, while ConsensusSynthesizer counts successful objects rather than distinct shared-predicate-eligible terminal vendors; an ineligible result can therefore alter groups and inflate serialized quorum when other eligible votes satisfy the precheck.
findings.resolution: Remove the success-only fallback for convergence, deduplicate/filter by eligible terminal_vendor before checkpointing and synthesis, and make ConsensusSynthesizer consume the shared eligibility decision rather than a raw success flag.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:201 still requires exact type equality before any location evidence and implements no taxonomy-family aliases, so differently classified descriptions of the same defect cannot be cross-confirmed as the contract requires.
findings.resolution: Normalize types into configured families and score normalized location, symbol, and requirement evidence before description similarity, including the specified same-location cross-family path.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:433 includes vendor identity and vendor-local finding ID in each concern fingerprint, so an unchanged concern receives a different group_id when reviewer allocation or finding order changes and valid adjudications become stale across rounds.
findings.resolution: Derive fingerprints solely from normalized concern content, location, type family, symbol, and requirement identity; exclude vendor names and source-local IDs, then add cross-vendor and renumbering stability tests.
